assignments.role: Backend Audio Mix Controls, Prominent Safe Text Overlays & Dynamic Script Pacing
assignments.scope: 1) Music & Sound Mix Controls: In web/pipeline_bridge.py, implement parse_music_directives(text) to extract mute_music ('بدون موسيقى', 'كتم الموسيقى'), music_track ('luxury_piano', 'acoustic_guitar', 'ambient_meditation'), and music_volume ('صوت الموسيقى 10%'). When mute_music is True, build FFmpeg filtergraph omitting background music completely for 100% clean voiceover. Lower default ambient volume to 0.16 and tune ducking (threshold=0.015, ratio=12.0). 2) Prominent Safe Text Overlays: In web/video_annotator.py and pipeline_bridge.py, support large_font detection ('بخط كبير', 'واضح'), boosting font size to max(48, min(64, int(target_h * 0.042))) with high-contrast box (black@0.78, boxborderw=16). Elevate bottom position to safe_margin = max(110, int(video_height * 0.085)) avoiding player controls. 3) Property Features & Dynamic Script Pacing: In web/pipeline_bridge.py and web/vision_analyzer.py, implement extract_property_features(text) capturing unit ('F5'), sea_view ('مطل على البحر'), and property_type ('منزل'). Expand target_words to max(18, min(160, int(speech_duration * 2.1))) removing the 65-word clamp. Inject mandatory architectural specs and 3-phase dynamic continuity instructions into Gemini Vision prompt. In _get_smart_fallback and _generate_dynamic_darja_script, dynamically scale narration length across duration so speech remains engaging without abrupt silence. 4) Author tests in tests/test_prompt_customizations_and_dynamism.py. 5) Zero U+0669. Update web/README.md. Commit as MohammedBoure. Signal idle via notify_coordinator_worker_idle.
